Speakers

Meet the engineers, founders, and researchers shaping the future of technology. Our 2024 line-up spans AI, cloud infrastructure, design systems, and developer experience — curated to challenge how you build and lead.

Full Line-Up

Dana Reyes

Chief AI Officer, Lumenworks

Dana leads applied AI research at Lumenworks, shipping large-scale recommendation systems used by millions daily. She previously built ML infrastructure at two unicorn startups.

Marcus Oduya

Principal Engineer, CloudPivot

Marcus designs distributed systems that power CloudPivot's global edge network. He is a frequent contributor to open-source networking projects and a mentor for new engineers.

Priya Nandakumar

Founder & CEO, Formless Design

Priya built Formless Design into a leading design-systems studio after a decade at major tech companies. She speaks widely on scaling design culture inside engineering teams.

Tomas Lindqvist

VP Engineering, SecureStack

Tomas has spent fifteen years hardening infrastructure against emerging threats. At SecureStack he leads a team focused on zero-trust architecture for enterprise clients.

Aisha Bello

Developer Advocate, OpenRuntime

Aisha helps developers adopt modern tooling through workshops, documentation, and live coding sessions. She was previously a backend engineer at a fintech scale-up.

Ethan Walsh

Research Scientist, DeepField Labs

Ethan studies the intersection of robotics and machine perception. His recent work on sensor fusion has been adopted by several autonomous vehicle manufacturers.

Sofia Marchetti

CTO, GreenGrid Energy

Sofia builds software that optimizes renewable energy grids in real time. She champions sustainable engineering practices across the tech industry.

Raj Patel

Head of Platform, ScaleOps

Raj oversees platform reliability for one of the largest SaaS products in logistics. He is passionate about turning incident retrospectives into lasting engineering culture.

pages.html:
nexus_conf
HomeSpeakersScheduleTickets

Tickets — NexusConf 2024

Join over 2,000 developers, architects, and tech leaders at NexusConf 2024, September 18–19 in Austin, TX. Choose the pass that fits your team and lock in your seat — prices increase as the event gets closer.

Ticket Tiers

Standard

$349

  • Access to all keynotes & breakout sessions
  • Conference swag bag
  • Lunch & coffee breaks (2 days)
  • Access to recorded sessions for 30 days
Buy Standard Ticket

Most Popular

Pro

$599

  • Everything in Standard
  • Reserved front-section seating
  • Access to 3 hands-on workshops
  • Exclusive speaker networking dinner
  • 1-year access to recorded sessions
Buy Pro Ticket

VIP

$999

  • Everything in Pro
  • Private VIP lounge access
  • 1:1 mentorship slot with a speaker
  • Priority seating at all sessions
  • Limited-edition NexusConf jacket
Buy VIP Ticket

All prices in USD and exclude applicable taxes. Student discounts are available — see the FAQ below.

Ticket FAQ

Can I get a refund if I can't attend?

Yes. Tickets are fully refundable up to 30 days before the event. Within 30 days, we offer a free transfer to a colleague or a credit toward NexusConf 2025.

Do you offer student discounts?

Yes, students with a valid .edu email address receive 50% off the Standard ticket. Email hello@nexusconf.example with proof of enrollment to request a discount code.

Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?

Absolutely. Transfers are free and can be made any time before September 1, 2024 by emailing our support team with the new attendee's details.

Is there a group discount?

Groups of 5 or more receive 15% off per ticket, and groups of 10 or more receive 25% off. Use the reservation form below to request a group quote or invoice.

What's included with workshop access?

Pro and VIP tickets include access to hands-on workshops, which require separate room sign-up on-site due to limited seating. All materials and equipment are provided.

Group Reservation & Invoice Request

Booking for a team, or need an invoice instead of a card payment? Fill out the form below and our events team will follow up within one business day.

Ticket FAQ

Can I get a refund if I can't attend?

Yes. Tickets are fully refundable up to 30 days before the event. Within 30 days, we offer a free transfer to a colleague or a credit toward NexusConf 2025.

Do you offer student discounts?

Yes, students with a valid .edu email address receive 50% off the Standard ticket. Email hello@nexusconf.example with proof of enrollment to request a discount code.

Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?

Absolutely. Transfers are free and can be made any time before September 1, 2024 by emailing our support team with the new attendee's details.

Is there a group discount?

Groups of 5 or more receive 15% off per ticket, and groups of 10 or more receive 25% off. Use the reservation form below to request a group quote or invoice.

What's included with workshop access?

Pro and VIP tickets include access to hands-on workshops, which require separate room sign-up on-site due to limited seating. All materials and equipment are provided.
